#### Performance Suspension Specialist

Ridetech manufactures exciting suspension systems that improve the handling and ride quality of your muscle car, truck, Corvette or hot rod. From restorations and show cars, to high-speed autocross and track day cars, Ridetech offers a wide range of premium products including air suspension systems (air ride), coil-overs, shock absorbers, coil and leaf springs, tubular control arms, roll bars, sway bars and much more.

detail: building landing page from copy.md and images/

content.text:
I built the landing page as a single file, `index.html`, in the project folder. It uses your `images/` folder as it is. I haven't opened it in a browser or tested it, so the layout and carousel are unchecked.

**What's on the page, top to bottom:**
- **Top bar and header:** a bar with the phone number, newsletter link, free catalog link and login. Below it is a sticky header with the logo, dropdown menus (Products, Applications, News, Tech) and a cart link. On small screens the menu collapses into a Menu button.
- **Hero carousel:** the four banner images (Silverado, RidePRO-E5, Falcon, Camaro). It rotates automatically and has arrows and dots.
- **Free shipping banner:** a red strip with the free ground shipping offer.
- **Shop by Vehicle:** five dark cards that use the red car-silhouette icons.
- **Shop by Product:** 21 category cards. Eleven use your product photos. The other ten have no image in the content, so they appear as text-only cards with a red edge.
- **Free catalog:** the catalog cover with a "Request a Catalog" button, plus a link to the 1,000,001 mile warranty page.
- **Latest News:** the two articles and a "View all news" button.
- **About:** the "Performance Suspension Specialist" text over `para-bg.jpg`, with email, phone and social links.
- **Get Connected:** the newsletter form.
- **Footer:** contact info, link columns and the copyright line.

**Things to know:**
- All links point to the live ridetech.com URLs from your copy.
- The newsletter form doesn't send anywhere. It only changes the button to "Thanks!", so it needs a real endpoint.
- The cart link is static "$0.00" and the search box from your copy isn't included.
